newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates remained unchanged on Friday owing to low buying interest from spinners, brokers said.
"There is no buying interest from spinners," broker Adil Nasim at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.

In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,250 and 2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 between 2,525 and 2,550 and the MNH-93 between 2,525 and 2,575, he said. The rates were likely to open at the same level on Saturday.
